subject.title: feat(cli): add lightweight context flag to agent turns

question: Should `openclaw agent` expose lightweight bootstrap context as a supported public CLI flag for scripted one-shot runs?
rationale: The implementation appears to expose an existing runtime mode without changing defaults, but a new documented CLI flag is a public product/API commitment rather than a purely mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in CLI flag
options.body: Accept the narrow public surface after the contributor provides redacted live Gateway and local-run proof of the documented context behavior.

options.title: Keep lightweight mode internal
options.body: Decline the new CLI flag and retain lightweight bootstrap selection for existing internal owners such as scheduled or subagent runs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in CLI flag
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow public surface after the contributor provides redacted live Gateway and local-run proof of the documented context behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author can provide the requested execution evidence, although current-main ownership needs maintainer routing.
